passages.note: Final-passage vote on the Conference Committee Report passed 50-0 (0 Nay), so it is near-unanimous and cannot carry the chair alone.

passages.provision_quote: (3) For taxable years beginning after December 31, 2016, and before January 1, 2023, three and twenty-three hundredths percent (3.23%). (4) For taxable years beginning after December 31, 2022, and before January 1, 2025, three and fifteen hundredths percent (3.15%).
passages.note: Enrolled text of HB 1002 cuts the individual income tax rate from 3.23% to 3.15% and phases it down further, a broad cut to the main individual rate matching rung 4.
Bill details page lists Mishler as a Senate sponsor of HB 1002, evidencing the bill as filed regardless of the near-unanimous vote.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Ryan Mishler, Sen. Travis Holdman, Sen. Lonnie Randolph.

rows.reasoning: Mishler is listed as a Senate sponsor of HB 1002 (2022), whose enrolled text cuts the individual adjusted gross income tax rate from 3.23% to 3.15% (and further in later years), a broad reduction to the main individual rate matching rung 4, 'Cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay.' The Conference Committee Report passed 50-0, so the vote alone is near-unanimous and cannot carry the chair, but sponsorship evidences the bill as filed.
